detail.body:
## Summary

Add **FLUX.1-dev** support for the AMDiffusionBenchmark (AMDB), reusing the existing Primus diffusion backend and native FLUX implementation.

This PR introduces the shared AMDB benchmark infrastructure and integrates FLUX.1-dev without duplicating existing model code.

## Changes

### Shared AMDB infrastructure
- Add `AMDBBenchmarkTrainer`, extending the existing `FSDP2Trainer`.
- Add shared benchmark dataset loading and checkpoint download support.
- Reuse the existing training step loop, even-size batch handling, and gradient-norm short-circuit in `trainers/base.py`.
- Integrate with the existing model registry, argument builder, logging, and checkpoint preparation paths.

### FLUX.1-dev integration
- Reuse the native FLUX implementation under `models/flux/` and `models/registrations/flux.py`.
- Add opt-in AMDB-specific behavior:
  - BFL QK-norm epsilon (`1e-6`).
  - Logit-normal timestep sampling.
  - Pre-encoded latent support.
  - Triton RoPE implementation (`models/flux/rope_triton.py`).
- Reuse the existing `data/flux_precomputed.py` image loader.
- Keep the existing `flux.1-dev` and `flux.1-schnell` execution paths unchanged unless the new benchmark options are explicitly enabled.

## Reused Components

- `models/flux/layers.py`
- `models/flux/model.py`
- `models/flux/adapter.py`
- `models/flux/train_pipeline.py`
- `models/flux/autoencoder.py`
- `models/flux/conditioner.py`
- `models/flux/math.py`
- `models/registrations/flux.py`

## Validation
- [x] End-to-end AMDB benchmark training.

+
+| Workload | MI300X / MI325X | MI355X |
+|---|---:|---:|
+| flux-dev | 10 | 16 |
+
+Use `examples/diffusion/configs/MI300X` or `MI325X` on those GPUs. Keep
+`SP_SIZE` at 1.
+
+`benchmark_flux_dev-posttrain.yaml` fine-tunes the native FLUX.1-dev module.
+Set `PRETRAINED_PATH` to `flux1-dev.safetensors` and `VAE_CHECKPOINT` to
+`ae.safetensors`.

+        "fsdp_module_paths_to_wrap": "",
+        "fsdp2_reshard_after_forward": True,
+        "fsdp2_pure_low_precision": True,
+        "compile_transformer_blocks": False,
+        "save_strategy": "dit_only",
+        "sp_size": 1,
+        "dp_replicate": 1,
+    },
+}
+
+# Registered on later benchmark PRs. Reject them here so this release does not
+# build trainer defaults, or download checkpoints, for a model it cannot run.
+_UNBUILT_BENCHMARKS = {
+    "sdxl",
+    "stable-diffusion-xl",
+    "mochi-1",
+    "hunyuan-video",
+    "wan2.1-i2v",
+}
+
+
+def _positive_image_size(value: Any) -> int:
+    try:
+        number = float(value)
+    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+        raise ValueError(f"flux-dev image size must be a positive integer, got {value!r}") from exc
+    if number <= 0 or number != int(number):
+        raise ValueError(f"flux-dev image size must be a positive integer, got {value!r}")
+    return int(number)
+
+
+def _square_image_size(resolution: Any) -> int:
+    """Parse a square benchmark resolution.
+
+    Accepts ``512``, ``512.0``, ``"512"``, ``"512x512"``, ``"512,512"`` and
+    ``[512, 512]``. A non-square pair is rejected instead of keeping one side.
+    """
+    if isinstance(resolution, bool) or resolution is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"flux-dev resolution must be a positive size, got {resolution!r}")
+    if isinstance(resolution, (int, float)):
+        return _positive_image_size(resolution)
+    if isinstance(resolution, (list, tuple)):
+        parts = list(resolution)
+    else:
+        text = str(resolution).strip().lower().replace(" ", "")
+        if not text:
+            raise ValueError("flux-dev resolution is empty")
+        parts = [text]
+        for separator in ("x", "*", ","):
+            if separator in text:
+                parts = [part for part in text.split(separator) if part]
+                break
+    if len(parts) == 1:
+        return _positive_image_size(parts[0])
+    if len(parts) == 2:
+        height = _positive_image_size(parts[0])
+        width = _positive_image_size(parts[1])
+        if height != width:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"flux-dev resolution must be square, got {resolution!r}. Set data.img_size to one side length."
+            )
+        return height
+    raise ValueError(f"flux-dev resolution must be a size or HxW pair, got {resolution!r}")
+
+
+def benchmark_defaults(
+    model_name: str,
+    *,
+    flux_dataset: dict[str, Any],
+    flux_trainer: dict[str, Any],
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]] | None:
+    if model_name == "flux-dev":
+        dataset = copy.deepcopy(flux_dataset)
+        dataset["config"]["dataset_type"] = "raw"
+        dataset["config"]["dataset_format"] = "hf_repo"
+        dataset["config"]["dataset_path"] = ""
+        processor = dataset["config"]["processor_config"]
+        processor["img_size"] = 512
+        processor["processor_name"] = "flux_raw"
+        processor["processor_type"] = "flux_raw"
+        processor["skip_low_resolution"] = False
+        dataset["config"]["benchmark_loader"] = True
+        trainer = copy.deepcopy(BENCHMARK_TRAINER)
+        trainer["args"]["run_name"] = "flux-dev"
+        trainer["args"]["fsdp_transformer_layer_cls_to_wrap"] = "DoubleStreamBlock,SingleStreamBlock"
+        trainer["args"]["fsdp_module_paths_to_wrap"] = flux_trainer["args"]["fsdp_module_paths_to_wrap"]
+        trainer["args"]["fsdp_module_paths_no_reshard"] = flux_trainer["args"]["fsdp_module_paths_no_reshard"]
+        return dataset, trainer
+    if model_name in _UNBUILT_BENCHMARKS:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{model_name} has no diffusion model builder. "
+            "This release registers the flux-dev benchmark only, so the config is rejected "
+            "before any checkpoint or dataset download."
+        )
+    return None
+
+
+def apply_benchmark_sections(
+    model_name: str,
+    *,
+    data: dict[str, Any],
+    trainer_args: dict[str, Any],
+    dataset_cfg: dict[str, Any],
+    normalized: dict[str, Any],
+) -> None:
+    if model_name == "flux-dev":
+        # Precomputed FLUX samples are mean/logvar encodings, not AMDB images.
+        # Leaving the dataset on the flux loader avoids the latent-cache path
+        # looking up a missing ``image`` key.
+        resolution = data.get("resolution")
+        model_cfg = normalized["model"].get("config")
+        if resolution is None and isinstance(model_cfg, dict):
+            resolution = model_cfg.get("resolution")
+        # An explicit data.img_size is already copied onto the processor.
+        # The model YAML always sets resolution, so it must not replace that size.
+        if data.get("img_size") is None and resolution is not None:
+            processor = dataset_cfg.setdefault("processor_config", {})
+            processor["img_size"] = _square_image_size(resolution)
+        if int(trainer_args.get("sp_size", 1)) != 1:
+            raise ValueError("flux-dev diffusion training requires `parallelism.sp_size: 1`.")

+###############################################################################

+#
+# See LICENSE for license information.
+###############################################################################
+
+"""Hugging Face datasets used by the AMDiffusionBenchmark workloads."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import zipfile
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+
+from primus.backends.diffusion.data.collator import RawBatchCollator
+
+_SIHEYUAN = "chinese_architecture_siheyuan"
+_PROMPT_KEYS = ("prompt", "text", "caption", "txt", "caption_0")
+
+
+_IMAGE_SUFFIXES = {".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp"}
+
+
+def is_siheyuan_dataset(dataset_path: str) -> bool:
+    text = str(dataset_path).replace("\\", "/")
+    local = Path(text).expanduser()
+    return _SIHEYUAN in text or (local.is_dir() and (local / "siheyuan.zip").is_file())
+
+
+def siheyuan_image_members(names: list[str]) -> list[str]:
+    return sorted(
+        name for name in names if not name.endswith("/") and Path(name).suffix.lower() in _IMAGE_SUFFIXES
+    )
+
+
+def read_siheyuan_images(dataset_path: str) -> list[tuple[str, bytes]] | None:
+    """The 156-image train split: JPEGs from both archives, then the log PNGs.
+
+    ``load_dataset`` on this repo also yields npz, txt, and caption members, so
+    the decoded split is larger than the real training images.
+    """
+    local = Path(str(dataset_path)).expanduser()
+    if not local.is_dir() or not is_siheyuan_dataset(str(local)):
+        return None
+    rows: list[tuple[str, bytes]] = []
+    for archive_path in sorted(local.glob("*.zip")):
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
+            for name in siheyuan_image_members(archive.namelist()):
+                rows.append((name, archive.read(name)))
+    for path in sorted(local.rglob("*.png")):
+        rows.append((path.name, path.read_bytes()))
+    if not rows:
+        raise ValueError(f"{local} has no siheyuan train images")
+    return rows
+
+
+def load_benchmark_image_dataset(dataset_path: str):
+    """Load an image dataset. Siheyuan uses its 156-image train split."""
+    from datasets import Dataset, Image, load_dataset
+
+    images = read_siheyuan_images(dataset_path)
+    if images is not None:
+        records = {
+            "image": [{"path": name, "bytes": payload} for name, payload in images],
+            "caption": [Path(name).stem.replace("_", " ") for name, _payload in images],
+        }
+        return Dataset.from_dict(records).cast_column("image", Image())
+    return load_dataset(str(dataset_path), **image_dataset_load_kwargs(dataset_path))
+
+
+def image_dataset_load_kwargs(dataset_path: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Load arguments for a Hugging Face image dataset."""
+    del dataset_path
+    return {"split": "train", "verification_mode": "no_checks"}
+
+
+def caption_from_image_filename(image: Any) -> str:
+    """Caption used by AMDiffusionBenchmark: the filename stem, underscores as spaces."""
+    filename = getattr(image, "filename", "") or ""
+    stem = Path(str(filename)).stem
+    return stem.replace("_", " ") if stem else ""
+
+
+class AMDBDataset:
+    """One image sample plus an optional caption."""
+
+    def __init__(self, records: Any, *, modality: str):
+        if modality != "image":
+            raise ValueError(f"amdb modality must be 'image', got {modality!r}")
+        self.records = records
+        self.modality = modality
+        self._logged_skips: set[int] = set()
+
+    def __len__(self) -> int:
+        return len(self.records)
+
+    def __getitem__(self, index: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        count = len(self.records)
+        last_error: Exception | None = None
+        for offset in range(count):
+            row_index = (index + offset) % count
+            try:
+                return self._sample_from_row(self.records[row_index])
+            except (OSError, RuntimeError, ValueError) as exc:
+                last_error = exc
+                if row_index not in self._logged_skips:
+                    self._logged_skips.add(row_index)
+                    from primus.backends.diffusion.utils.log import logger
+
+                    logger.warning(
+                        "Skipping undecodable amdb %s sample %s: %s",
+                        self.modality,
+                        row_index,
+                        exc,
+                    )
+        raise RuntimeError(f"amdb dataset has no decodable {self.modality} sample") from last_error
+
+    def _sample_from_row(self, row: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:

+
+"""Fused FLUX rotary embedding.
+
+Same math as ``apply_rope`` in ``math.py`` (FP32 rotation of interleaved
+pairs, result cast back to the input dtype) in one kernel per tensor. The
+rotation is linear, so the backward pass is the same kernel with the sine
+negated and nothing but the angles is saved.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+from torch import Tensor
+
+try:
+    import triton
+    import triton.language as tl
+except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover - triton ships with ROCm/CUDA torch builds
+    triton = None
+
+
+if triton is not None:
+
+    @triton.jit
+    def _rope_kernel(
+        x_ptr, cos_ptr, sin_ptr, out_ptr, heads, sign, HALF: tl.constexpr, BLOCK_H: tl.constexpr
+    ):
+        token = tl.program_id(0)
+        h = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_H)[:, None]
+        d = tl.arange(0, HALF)[None, :]
+        mask = h < heads
+        base = token.to(tl.int64) * heads * (2 * HALF) + h * (2 * HALF) + 2 * d
+        x0 = tl.load(x_ptr + base, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+        x1 = tl.load(x_ptr + base + 1, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+        angle = token.to(tl.int64) * HALF + d
+        c = tl.load(cos_ptr + angle)
+        s = tl.load(sin_ptr + angle) * sign
+        tl.store(out_ptr + base, (c * x0 - s * x1).to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=mask)
+        tl.store(out_ptr + base + 1, (s * x0 + c * x1).to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=mask)
+
+
+def _launch(x: Tensor, cos: Tensor, sin: Tensor, sign: float) -> Tensor:
+    x = x.contiguous()
+    out = torch.empty_like(x)
+    tokens = x.shape[0] * x.shape[1]
+    heads = x.shape[2]
+    half = x.shape[3] // 2
+    _rope_kernel[(tokens,)](x, cos, sin, out, heads, sign, HALF=half, BLOCK_H=triton.next_power_of_2(heads))
+    return out
+
+
+class _FusedRope(torch.autograd.Function):
+    @staticmethod
+    def forward(ctx, x: Tensor, cos: Tensor, sin: Tensor) -> Tensor:
+        ctx.save_for_backward(cos, sin)
+        return _launch(x, cos, sin, 1.0)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def backward(ctx, grad: Tensor):
+        cos, sin = ctx.saved_tensors
+        return _launch(grad, cos, sin, -1.0), None, None
+
+
+def fused_rope_supported(x: Tensor, freqs_cis: Tensor) -> bool:
+    if triton is None or not x.is_cuda or freqs_cis.requires_grad:
+        return False
+    if x.ndim != 4 or freqs_cis.ndim != 6 or freqs_cis.shape[2] != 1 or freqs_cis.shape[-2:] != (2, 2):
+        return False
+    half = x.shape[3] // 2
+    if x.shape[3] % 2 or half & (half - 1) or freqs_cis.shape[3] != half:
+        return False
+    return freqs_cis.shape[1] == x.shape[1] and freqs_cis.shape[0] in (1, x.shape[0])
+
+
+def _shared_cos_sin(freqs_cis: Tensor, shape: tuple[int, int, int]) -> tuple[Tensor, Tensor]:
+    """Reuse one fp32 cos/sin pair for every block that sees this ``pe``."""
+    cached = getattr(_shared_cos_sin, "cached", None)
+    if cached is not None and cached[0] is freqs_cis and cached[1] == shape:

+    """Yield only full batches for the AMDiffusionBenchmark step metrics.

+    The tail is padded from the front of this sampler, which is the rank-local
+    shard, so every step has ``batch_size`` examples. FPS and TFLOPS then use

+    repeated samples would be counted again.

+        if batch_size < 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"batch_size must be positive, got {batch_size}")
+        self.sampler = sampler

+
+    def __iter__(self):
+        indices = list(self.sampler)
+        if not indices:
+            return
+        front = indices[: self.batch_size]
+        while len(front) < self.batch_size:
+            front = (front + front)[: self.batch_size]
+        batch: list[int] = []
+        for index in indices:
+            batch.append(index)
+            if len(batch) == self.batch_size:
+                yield batch
+                batch = []
+        if batch:
+            need = self.batch_size - len(batch)
+            yield batch + front[:need]
+
+    def __len__(self) -> int:
+        count = len(self.sampler)
+        if count == 0:
+            return 0
+        return math.ceil(count / self.batch_size)

+###############################################################################

+"""Download AMDiffusionBenchmark models and datasets into the Hugging Face cache.
+
+``primus-cli`` runs this from the diffusion prepare hook, before the training
+processes start. Model repos land in ``<cache>/hub``. Dataset repos land in
+``<cache>/datasets/<org>/<name>``. The cache root is ``PRIMUS_HF_HOME`` when
+that is set. Otherwise an explicit ``HF_HOME`` is used, except when it equals
+the runner's automatic ``$DATA_PATH/huggingface``. The fallback is
+``~/cache/huggingface``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+_MODEL_FILES: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {
+    "flux-dev": ("black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev", "flux1-dev.safetensors"),
+}
+_DATASETS: dict[str, tuple[str, str | None]] = {
+    "flux-dev": ("frank-chieng/chinese_architecture_siheyuan", None),
+}
+
+
+def _log(message: str) -> None:
+    print(f"[INFO] diffusion assets: {message}", file=sys.stderr)
+
+
+def huggingface_home() -> Path:
+    """Cache directory for benchmark downloads."""
+    requested = os.environ.get("PRIMUS_HF_HOME")
+    if requested:
+        return Path(requested).expanduser()
+    current = os.environ.get("HF_HOME")
+    data_path = os.environ.get("DATA_PATH")
+    automatic = str(Path(data_path) / "huggingface") if data_path else None
+    if current and current != automatic:
+        return Path(current).expanduser()
+    return Path.home() / "cache" / "huggingface"
+
+
+def dataset_root() -> Path:
+    """Folder that holds dataset repos, separate from the model hub cache."""
+    root = huggingface_home() / "datasets"
+    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    return root
+
+
+def dataset_folder(repo_id: str) -> Path:
+    """Stable directory for one dataset repo: ``datasets/<org>/<name>``."""
+    return dataset_root() / repo_id
+
+
+def configure_huggingface_cache() -> Path:
+    """Point Hugging Face clients at the benchmark cache for this process."""
+    home = huggingface_home()
+    hub = home / "hub"
+    processed = home / "datasets-cache"
+    home.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    hub.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    dataset_root()
+    processed.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    os.environ["HF_HOME"] = str(home)
+    os.environ["HF_HUB_CACHE"] = str(hub)
+    os.environ["HUGGINGFACE_HUB_CACHE"] = str(hub)
+    os.environ["HF_DATASETS_CACHE"] = str(processed)
+    _link_existing_token(home)
+    return home
+
+
+def cache_env() -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Environment lines the prepare hook exports to the training processes."""
+    home = configure_huggingface_cache()
+    return {
+        "HF_HOME": str(home),
+        "HF_HUB_CACHE": str(home / "hub"),
+        "HUGGINGFACE_HUB_CACHE": str(home / "hub"),
+        "HF_DATASETS_CACHE": str(home / "datasets-cache"),
+    }
+
+
+def _link_existing_token(home: Path) -> None:
+    """Use an existing ``~/.hf_token`` without copying or printing it."""
+    destination = home / "token"
+    source = Path.home() / ".hf_token"
+    if destination.exists() or destination.is_symlink() or not source.is_file():
+        return
+    destination.symlink_to(source)
+
+
+def _is_hf_repo(value: str) -> bool:
+    path = Path(value).expanduser()
+    if path.exists() or value.startswith(("/", "./", "../", "~")):
+        return False
+    parts = value.split("/")
+    if len(parts) < 2 or not all(parts[:2]):
+        return False
+    return not parts[-1].endswith((".safetensors", ".bin", ".pt", ".pth", ".ckpt"))
+
+
+def _snapshot(
+    repo_id: str,
+    *,
+    revision: str | None = None,
+    allow_patterns: list[str] | None = None,
+) -> str:
+    from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
+
+    home = configure_huggingface_cache()
+    _log(f"Downloading {repo_id} (model) into {home / 'hub'}")
+    kwargs: dict[str, object] = {"repo_id": repo_id, "cache_dir": str(home / "hub")}
+    if revision:
+        kwargs["revision"] = revision
+    if allow_patterns:
+        kwargs["allow_patterns"] = allow_patterns
+    return snapshot_download(**kwargs)
+
+
+def _snapshot_dataset(repo_id: str, *, revision: str | None = None) -> str:
+    """Download a dataset repo into ``datasets/<org>/<name>``, not the model hub."""
+    from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
+
+    configure_huggingface_cache()
+    local_dir = dataset_folder(repo_id)
+    local_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    blob_cache = dataset_root() / ".hub"
+    blob_cache.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    _log(f"Downloading {repo_id} (dataset) into {local_dir}")
+    kwargs: dict[str, str] = {
+        "repo_id": repo_id,
+        "repo_type": "dataset",
+        "cache_dir": str(blob_cache),
+        "local_dir": str(local_dir),
+    }
+    if revision:
+        kwargs["revision"] = revision
+    snapshot_download(**kwargs)
+    return str(local_dir)
+
+
+def materialize_pretrained(model_name: str, pretrained: str | None) -> str:
+    """Return a local checkpoint path, downloading the official repo when needed."""
+    spec = _MODEL_FILES.get(model_name)
+    if spec is None:
+        return str(pretrained or "")
+    default_repo, relative = spec
+    text = str(pretrained or "").strip()
+    local = Path(text).expanduser() if text else None
+    if local is not None and local.exists():
+        return str(local)
+    repo_id = default_repo
+    filename = relative
+    remote_file = text.count("/") >= 2 and not text.startswith(("/", ".", "~"))
+    if text and _is_hf_repo(text):
+        repo_id = text
+    elif remote_file:
+        org, _, remainder = text.partition("/")
+        name, _, filename = remainder.partition("/")
+        repo_id = f"{org}/{name}"
+        filename = filename or relative
+    elif text:
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{model_name} checkpoint does not exist: {text}")
+    snapshot = _snapshot(repo_id)
+    target = Path(snapshot) / filename
+    if not target.exists():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{repo_id} has no {filename} in {snapshot}")
+    _log(f"{model_name} checkpoint: {target}")
+    return str(target)
+
+
+def materialize_dataset(model_name: str, dataset_path: str | None, revision: str | None = None) -> str:
+    """Return a local dataset directory, downloading the repo when needed."""
+    default = _DATASETS.get(model_name)
+    text = str(dataset_path or "").strip()
+    if text.endswith(".pt"):
+        return text
+    local = Path(text).expanduser() if text else None
+    if local is not None and local.exists():
+        return str(local)
+    if text and _is_hf_repo(text):
+        repo_id = text
+        rev = revision
+    elif not text and default is not None:
+        repo_id, rev = default
+    else:
+        return text
+    return _snapshot_dataset(repo_id, revision=rev)
+
+
+def prefetch_huggingface_repo(value: str | None) -> None:
+    text = str(value or "").strip()
+    if text and _is_hf_repo(text):
+        _snapshot(text)
+
+
+def _blank(value: object) -> bool:
+    text = str(value or "").strip()
+    return not text or text.startswith("/path/to/")
+
+
+def _checkpoint_root(weights: str) -> Path:
+    path = Path(weights)
+    if path.is_file():
+        return path.parent
+    return path
+
+
+def _require_file(path: Path, description: str) -> str:
+    if not path.exists():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{description} was not in the downloaded snapshot: {path}")
+    return str(path)
+
+
+def _companion_paths(model_name: str, weights: str, encoder: dict[str, object]) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Local encoder files that belong to the downloaded checkpoint."""
+    if not weights or model_name != "flux-dev":
+        return {}
+    root = _checkpoint_root(weights)
+    if not _blank(encoder.get("autoencoder")):
+        return {}
+    return {"VAE_CHECKPOINT": _require_file(root / "ae.safetensors", "FLUX autoencoder")}
+
+
+_ENCODER_ENV_KEYS = {
+    "VAE_CHECKPOINT": "autoencoder",
+}

+    env = cache_env()

+    if weights and _replace_with_download(pretrained):
+        env["PRETRAINED_PATH"] = weights
+    data = materialize_dataset(model_name, dataset_path, revision=revision)
+    if data and data != str(dataset_path or "").strip() and _replace_with_download(dataset_path):

+    if os.environ.get("BENCHMARK_DENOISER_ONLY") != "1":
+        env.update(_companion_paths(model_name, weights, encoder))

+"""Load Hugging Face encoders without the retired safetensors conversion space."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+
+
+def disable_safetensors_auto_conversion() -> None:
+    """Stop Transformers from POSTing to ``safetensors-convert.hf.space``.
+
+    Repos such as ``google/t5-v1_1-xxl`` publish ``pytorch_model.bin`` and no
+    ``model.safetensors``. Transformers then starts ``Thread-auto_conversion``,
+    the space answers HTTP 405, and the thread raises ``KeyError: 'event_id'``.
+    The published PyTorch weights already load, so the conversion is unused.
+    """
+    try:
+        import transformers.safetensors_conversion as conversion
+    except Exception:
+        return
+    if getattr(conversion, "_primus_conversion_disabled", False):
+        return
+
+    original = conversion.auto_conversion
+
+    def auto_conversion(*args, **kwargs):
+        del args, kwargs
+        # modeling_utils unpacks ``resolved_archive_file, revision, is_sharded``.
+        # ``None`` raises ``TypeError: cannot unpack non-iterable NoneType``.
+        return None, None, False
+
+    conversion.auto_conversion = auto_conversion
+    conversion._primus_conversion_disabled = True
+    # from_pretrained may already have bound the original function.
+    for module in list(sys.modules.values()):
+        if module is not None and getattr(module, "auto_conversion", None) is original:
+            module.auto_conversion = auto_conversion

+"""Native equivalents of AMDiffusionBenchmark's timestep sampling helpers."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+
+
+def _shift(sigmas: torch.Tensor, shift: float) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return shift * sigmas / (1.0 + (shift - 1.0) * sigmas)
+
+
+def amdb_flow_sigma_grid(
+    *,
+    shift: float = 3.0,
+    num_train_timesteps: int = 1000,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Return AMDB's ``self.sigmas`` table, i.e. shifted ``scheduler.timesteps / N``.
+
+    FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler's training grid is ``linspace(1, N, N)[::-1] / N``.
+    AMDB's ``init_sigmas`` then applies ``--shift``.
+    """
+    n = num_train_timesteps
+    base = torch.arange(n, 0, -1, dtype=torch.float32) / n
+    return _shift(base, shift)
+
+
+def sample_shifted_logit_normal_sigmas(
+    batch_size: int,
+    *,
+    device: torch.device,
+    sigma_grid: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    shift: float = 3.0,
+    num_train_timesteps: int = 1000,
+    logit_mean: float = 0.0,
+    logit_std: float = 1.0,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Match AMDB's ``compute_density_based_timestep_sampling`` without Diffusers.
+
+    ``u = sigmoid(N(logit_mean, logit_std))`` is drawn on the CPU, as Diffusers'
+    ``compute_density_for_timestep_sampling`` does, and indexes the FP32 sigma table.
+    The returned FP32 sigma is both the noise level and AMDB's normalized timestep.
+    """
+    if sigma_grid is None:
+        sigma_grid = amdb_flow_sigma_grid(shift=shift, num_train_timesteps=num_train_timesteps)
+    u = torch.normal(mean=logit_mean, std=logit_std, size=(batch_size,), device="cpu").sigmoid_()
+    indices = (u * len(sigma_grid)).long().clamp_(max=len(sigma_grid) - 1)
+    # Pageable source: a non_blocking HIP copy can read the buffer after it is freed.
+    return sigma_grid[indices].to(device=device)

+def is_siheyuan_dataset(dataset_path: str) -> bool:

+    local = Path(text).expanduser()

+def siheyuan_image_members(names: list[str]) -> list[str]:

+def read_siheyuan_images(dataset_path: str) -> list[tuple[str, bytes]] | None:
+    """The 156-image train split: JPEGs from both archives, then the log PNGs.
+
+    ``load_dataset`` on this repo also yields npz, txt, and caption members, so
+    the decoded split is larger than the real training images.
+    """
+    local = Path(str(dataset_path)).expanduser()
+    if not local.is_dir() or not is_siheyuan_dataset(str(local)):
+        return None
+    rows: list[tuple[str, bytes]] = []
+    for archive_path in sorted(local.glob("*.zip")):
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
+            for name in siheyuan_image_members(archive.namelist()):
+                rows.append((name, archive.read(name)))
+    for path in sorted(local.rglob("*.png")):
+        rows.append((path.name, path.read_bytes()))
+    if not rows:
+        raise ValueError(f"{local} has no siheyuan train images")
+    return rows

+            msg += f" eta={eta_seconds / 60:.2f}m"
+        logger.info(msg)
+
+        if self.use_wandb:
+            global_batch_size = (
+                self.per_device_train_batch_size * self.grad_accum_steps * self.data_parallel_world_size
+            )
+            payload = {
+                "train/loss": loss_value,
+                "step_loss": step_loss_value,
+                "train_loss": loss_value,
+                "train/step": self.global_step,
+                "train/grad_norm": grad_norm,
+                "train/lr": lr,
+                "train/samples_count": self.global_step * global_batch_size,
+                "loss_metrics/global_avg_loss": loss_value,
+                "lr": lr,
+                "mem/allocated_gb": alloc,
+                "mem/reserved_gb": res,
+                "mem/max_alloc_gb": max_mem,
+            }
+            if step_time is not None:
+                payload["step_time_total"] = step_time
+            if step_time_gpu is not None:
+                payload["step_time_gpu"] = step_time_gpu
+            if throughput_samples_per_gpu_s is not None:
+                global_throughput = throughput_samples_per_gpu_s * self.world_size
+                payload["perf/fps_gpu"] = throughput_samples_per_gpu_s
+                payload["throughput(global_samples/s)"] = global_throughput
+            if tflops_per_gpu is not None:
+                payload["tflops/s"] = tflops_per_gpu
+            if elapsed is not None:
+                payload["time/elapsed_s"] = elapsed
+            if eta_seconds is not None:
+                payload["time/eta_s"] = eta_seconds
+            wandb.log(payload, step=self.global_step)
+
+    def train(self):
+        if self.rank == 0:
+            logger.info("Starting training...")
+        self._mlperf_log_run_start()
+
+        # Ensure frozen state (idempotent)
+        core = getattr(self.model, "module", self.model)
+        if hasattr(core, "freeze_except"):
+            core.freeze_except()
+
+        if bool(self.args.get("cache_latents", True)) and not self.mlperf_enabled:
+            self._cache_encoded_batches()
+
+        self.model.train()
+        self.optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+        torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()
+
+        start_time = time.time()
+        local_samples_in_update = 0
+        update_loss_sum = None
+        update_loss_count = 0
+        mlperf_train_started = False
+        count_flops = not bool(self.args.get("compile_transformer_blocks", False))
+        flop_counter = FlopCounterMode(display=False, depth=None) if count_flops else None
+        total_flops: float | None = None
+        flops_captured = flop_counter is None
+        flop_capture_open = False
+        if flop_counter is None and self.rank == 0:
+            logger.warning(
+                "Disabling TFLOPS/GPU calculation because compile_transformer_blocks is enabled, "
+                "matching AMDiffusionBenchmark."
+            )
+        # AMDiffusionBenchmark synchronizes all ranks before both timing events so each
+        # step time excludes skew carried over from the previous step.
+        barrier_around_timing = (
+            not self.mlperf_enabled
+            and torch.distributed.is_available()
+            and torch.distributed.is_initialized()
+            and self.world_size > 1
+        )
+        start_event_gpu = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+        end_event_gpu = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+        accum = max(1, self.grad_accum_steps)
+        steps_per_epoch = math.ceil(len(self.dataloader) / accum)
+        start_epoch = self.global_step // steps_per_epoch
+        resume_batch_offset = (self.global_step % steps_per_epoch) * accum
+
+        for epoch in range(start_epoch, self.num_train_epochs):
+            self.sampler.set_epoch(epoch)
+            if isinstance(self.sampler, ContiguousDistributedSampler):
+                sample_offset = (
+                    resume_batch_offset * self.per_device_train_batch_size if epoch == start_epoch else 0
+                )
+                self.sampler.set_offset(sample_offset)
+
+            start_time_step = time.time()
+            for batch_idx, batch in enumerate(self.dataloader):
+                batch = self._prepare_host_batch(batch)
+                if self.mlperf_enabled and not mlperf_train_started:
+                    self._mlperf_log_train_start()
+                    mlperf_train_started = True
+                is_update_step = ((batch_idx + 1) % accum) == 0
+                starts_update = (batch_idx % accum) == 0
+                local_samples_in_update += self._infer_local_batch_size(batch)
+                if starts_update:
+                    if barrier_around_timing:
+                        torch.distributed.barrier()
+                    start_event_gpu.record()
+                    if flop_counter is not None and not flops_captured:
+                        flop_counter.__enter__()
+                        flop_capture_open = True
+                if is_update_step:
+                    self._mlperf_log_block_start(self.global_step + 1)
+
+                with self._grad_sync_context(is_update_step):
+                    try:
+                        raw_loss = self.compute_loss(batch)
+                    except BaseException as exc:
+                        if flop_capture_open:
+                            flop_counter.__exit__(type(exc), exc, exc.__traceback__)
+                            flop_capture_open = False
+                            flops_captured = True

+###############################################################################
+# Copyright (c) 2025, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
+#
+# See LICENSE for license information.
+###############################################################################
+
+"""Download AMDiffusionBenchmark models and datasets into the Hugging Face cache.
+
+``primus-cli`` runs this from the diffusion prepare hook, before the training
+processes start. Model repos land in ``<cache>/hub``. Dataset repos land in
+``<cache>/datasets/<org>/<name>``. The cache root is ``PRIMUS_HF_HOME`` when
+that is set. Otherwise an explicit ``HF_HOME`` is used, except when it equals
+the runner's automatic ``$DATA_PATH/huggingface``. The fallback is
+``~/cache/huggingface``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+_MODEL_FILES: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {
+    "flux-dev": ("black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev", "flux1-dev.safetensors"),
+    "sdxl": ("stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0", "sd_xl_base_1.0.safetensors"),
+    "stable-diffusion-xl": ("stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0", "sd_xl_base_1.0.safetensors"),
+    "mochi-1": ("genmo/mochi-1-preview", "dit.safetensors"),
+    "hunyuan-video": ("hunyuanvideo-community/HunyuanVideo", "transformer"),
+    "wan2.1-i2v": ("Wan-AI/Wan2.1-I2V-14B-480P-Diffusers", "transformer"),
+}
+_DATASETS: dict[str, tuple[str, str | None]] = {
+    "flux-dev": ("frank-chieng/chinese_architecture_siheyuan", None),
+    "sdxl": ("frank-chieng/chinese_architecture_siheyuan", None),
+    "stable-diffusion-xl": ("frank-chieng/chinese_architecture_siheyuan", None),
+    "mochi-1": ("Wild-Heart/Disney-VideoGeneration-Dataset", "refs/pr/4"),
+    "hunyuan-video": ("Wild-Heart/Disney-VideoGeneration-Dataset", "refs/pr/4"),
+    "wan2.1-i2v": ("Wild-Heart/Disney-VideoGeneration-Dataset", "refs/pr/4"),
+}
+
+
+def _log(message: str) -> None:
+    print(f"[INFO] diffusion assets: {message}", file=sys.stderr)
+
+
+def huggingface_home() -> Path:
+    """Cache directory for benchmark downloads."""
+    requested = os.environ.get("PRIMUS_HF_HOME")
+    if requested:
+        return Path(requested).expanduser()
+    current = os.environ.get("HF_HOME")
+    data_path = os.environ.get("DATA_PATH")
+    automatic = str(Path(data_path) / "huggingface") if data_path else None
+    if current and current != automatic:
+        return Path(current).expanduser()
+    return Path.home() / "cache" / "huggingface"
+
+
+def dataset_root() -> Path:
+    """Folder that holds dataset repos, separate from the model hub cache."""
+    root = huggingface_home() / "datasets"
+    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    return root
+
+
+def dataset_folder(repo_id: str) -> Path:
+    """Stable directory for one dataset repo: ``datasets/<org>/<name>``."""
+    return dataset_root() / repo_id
+
+
+def configure_huggingface_cache() -> Path:
+    """Point Hugging Face clients at the benchmark cache for this process."""
+    home = huggingface_home()
+    hub = home / "hub"
+    processed = home / "datasets-cache"
+    home.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    hub.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    dataset_root()
+    processed.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    os.environ["HF_HOME"] = str(home)
+    os.environ["HF_HUB_CACHE"] = str(hub)
+    os.environ["HUGGINGFACE_HUB_CACHE"] = str(hub)
+    os.environ["HF_DATASETS_CACHE"] = str(processed)
+    _link_existing_token(home)
+    return home
+
+
+def cache_env() -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Environment lines the prepare hook exports to the training processes."""
+    home = configure_huggingface_cache()
+    return {
+        "HF_HOME": str(home),
+        "HF_HUB_CACHE": str(home / "hub"),
+        "HUGGINGFACE_HUB_CACHE": str(home / "hub"),
+        "HF_DATASETS_CACHE": str(home / "datasets-cache"),
+    }
+
+
+def _link_existing_token(home: Path) -> None:
+    """Use an existing ``~/.hf_token`` without copying or printing it."""
+    destination = home / "token"
+    source = Path.home() / ".hf_token"
+    if destination.exists() or destination.is_symlink() or not source.is_file():
+        return
+    destination.symlink_to(source)
+
+
+def _is_hf_repo(value: str) -> bool:
+    path = Path(value).expanduser()
+    if path.exists() or value.startswith(("/", "./", "../", "~")):
+        return False
+    parts = value.split("/")
+    if len(parts) < 2 or not all(parts[:2]):
+        return False
+    return not parts[-1].endswith((".safetensors", ".bin", ".pt", ".pth", ".ckpt"))
+
+
+def _snapshot(
+    repo_id: str,
+    *,
+    revision: str | None = None,
+    allow_patterns: list[str] | None = None,
+) -> str:
+    from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
+
+    home = configure_huggingface_cache()
+    _log(f"Downloading {repo_id} (model) into {home / 'hub'}")
+    kwargs: dict[str, object] = {"repo_id": repo_id, "cache_dir": str(home / "hub")}
+    if revision:
+        kwargs["revision"] = revision
+    if allow_patterns:
+        kwargs["allow_patterns"] = allow_patterns
+    return snapshot_download(**kwargs)
+
+
+def _snapshot_dataset(repo_id: str, *, revision: str | None = None) -> str:
+    """Download a dataset repo into ``datasets/<org>/<name>``, not the model hub."""
+    from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
+
+    configure_huggingface_cache()
+    local_dir = dataset_folder(repo_id)
+    local_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    blob_cache = dataset_root() / ".hub"
+    blob_cache.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    _log(f"Downloading {repo_id} (dataset) into {local_dir}")
+    kwargs: dict[str, str] = {
+        "repo_id": repo_id,
+        "repo_type": "dataset",
+        "cache_dir": str(blob_cache),
+        "local_dir": str(local_dir),
+    }
+    if revision:
+        kwargs["revision"] = revision
+    snapshot_download(**kwargs)
+    return str(local_dir)
+
+
+def materialize_pretrained(model_name: str, pretrained: str | None) -> str:
+    """Return a local checkpoint path, downloading the official repo when needed."""
+    spec = _MODEL_FILES.get(model_name)
+    if spec is None:
+        return str(pretrained or "")
+    default_repo, relative = spec
+    text = str(pretrained or "").strip()
+    local = Path(text).expanduser() if text else None
+    if local is not None and local.exists():
+        return str(local)
+    repo_id = default_repo
+    filename = relative
+    remote_file = text.count("/") >= 2 and not text.startswith(("/", ".", "~"))
+    if text and _is_hf_repo(text):
+        repo_id = text
+    elif remote_file:
+        org, _, remainder = text.partition("/")
+        name, _, filename = remainder.partition("/")
+        repo_id = f"{org}/{name}"
+        filename = filename or relative
+    elif text:
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{model_name} checkpoint does not exist: {text}")
+    snapshot = _snapshot(repo_id)
+    target = Path(snapshot) / filename
+    if not target.exists():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{repo_id} has no {filename} in {snapshot}")
+    _log(f"{model_name} checkpoint: {target}")
+    return str(target)
+
+
+def materialize_dataset(model_name: str, dataset_path: str | None, revision: str | None = None) -> str:
+    """Return a local dataset directory, downloading the repo when needed."""
+    default = _DATASETS.get(model_name)
+    text = str(dataset_path or "").strip()
+    if text.startswith("synthetic:") or text.endswith(".pt"):
+        return text
+    local = Path(text).expanduser() if text else None
+    if local is not None and local.exists():
+        return str(local)
+    if text and _is_hf_repo(text):
+        repo_id = text
+        rev = revision
+    elif not text and default is not None:
+        repo_id, rev = default
+    else:
+        return text
+    if repo_id == "Wild-Heart/Disney-VideoGeneration-Dataset" and not rev:
+        rev = "refs/pr/4"
+    return _snapshot_dataset(repo_id, revision=rev)
+
+
+def prefetch_huggingface_repo(value: str | None) -> None:
+    text = str(value or "").strip()
+    if text and _is_hf_repo(text):
+        _snapshot(text)
+
+
+def _blank(value: object) -> bool:
+    text = str(value or "").strip()
+    return not text or text.startswith("/path/to/")
+
+
+def _checkpoint_root(weights: str) -> Path:
+    path = Path(weights)
+    if path.is_file() or path.name == "transformer":
+        return path.parent
+    return path
+
+
+def tokenizer_dir(model_path: str) -> str:
+    """Tokenizer folder for a downloaded text encoder.
+
+    Diffusers snapshots keep ``tokenizer/`` next to ``text_encoder/``.
+    """
+    path = Path(model_path)
+    if (path / "tokenizer_config.json").is_file():
+        return str(path)
+    sibling = path.parent / "tokenizer"
+    if (sibling / "tokenizer_config.json").is_file():
+        return str(sibling)
+    return str(path)
+
+
+def _require_file(path: Path, description: str) -> str:
+    if not path.exists():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{description} was not in the downloaded snapshot: {path}")
+    return str(path)
+
+
+def _companion_paths(model_name: str, weights: str, encoder: dict[str, object]) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Local encoder files that belong to the downloaded checkpoint."""
+    if not weights:
+        return {}
+    root = _checkpoint_root(weights)
+    found: dict[str, str] = {}
+    if model_name == "flux-dev" and _blank(encoder.get("autoencoder")):
+        found["VAE_CHECKPOINT"] = _require_file(root / "ae.safetensors", "FLUX autoencoder")
+    elif model_name in {"sdxl", "stable-diffusion-xl"} and _blank(encoder.get("autoencoder")):
+        vae = Path(weights) if Path(weights).is_file() else root / "sd_xl_base_1.0.safetensors"
+        found["VAE_CHECKPOINT"] = _require_file(vae, "SDXL autoencoder")
+    elif model_name == "mochi-1" and _blank(encoder.get("autoencoder")):
+        found["VAE_CHECKPOINT"] = _require_file(root / "encoder.safetensors", "Mochi VAE encoder")
+    elif model_name == "hunyuan-video":
+        if _blank(encoder.get("llm")):
+            found["LLM_ENCODER"] = _require_file(root / "text_encoder", "HunyuanVideo LLaMA encoder")
+        # The community snapshot sometimes ships ``vae/`` and sometimes does not.
+        # Latent batches do not need it; raw video does, and the caller can set
+        # ``encoder.autoencoder`` when the folder lives somewhere else.
+        if _blank(encoder.get("autoencoder")) and (root / "vae").exists():
+            found["VAE_CHECKPOINT"] = str(root / "vae")
+    elif model_name == "wan2.1-i2v":
+        needed = {
+            "TEXT_ENCODER": "t5_encoder",
+            "VAE_CHECKPOINT": "autoencoder",
+            "CLIP_CHECKPOINT": "image_encoder",
+        }
+        if any(_blank(encoder.get(key)) for key in needed.values()):
+            snapshot = _snapshot(
+                "Wan-AI/Wan2.1-I2V-14B-480P",
+                allow_patterns=[
+                    "Wan2.1_VAE.pth",
+                    "models_t5_umt5-xxl-enc-bf16.pth",
+                    "models_clip_open-clip-xlm-roberta-large-vit-huge-14.pth",
+                ],
+            )
+            files = {
+                "TEXT_ENCODER": Path(snapshot) / "models_t5_umt5-xxl-enc-bf16.pth",
+                "VAE_CHECKPOINT": Path(snapshot) / "Wan2.1_VAE.pth",
+                "CLIP_CHECKPOINT": Path(snapshot) / "models_clip_open-clip-xlm-roberta-large-vit-huge-14.pth",
+            }
+            for env_key, cfg_key in needed.items():
+                if _blank(encoder.get(cfg_key)):
+                    found[env_key] = _require_file(files[env_key], env_key)
+    return found
+
+
+_ENCODER_ENV_KEYS = {

+"""Compatibility shim for Hugging Face ``datasets`` + torchvision >= 0.26.
+
+OSS torchvision no longer exports ``torchvision.io.VideoReader`` (see pytorch/vision#9373).
+Older ``datasets`` versions do ``from torchvision.io import VideoReader`` inside
+``Video.encode_example``, which breaks ``load_dataset`` on video columns.
+
+This module injects ``torchvision.io.VideoReader`` using torchcodec when available,
+otherwise decord (already used elsewhere in this repo), so the import succeeds and
+decoding yields ``{"data": CHW tensor}`` as expected by ``_preprocess_videos``.
+
+Call :func:`apply_torchvision_io_video_reader_shim` before ``import datasets``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+import sys
+from typing import Any, Iterator, Optional, Type
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+_applied = False
+
+
+def apply_torchvision_io_video_reader_shim() -> None:
+    """Attach ``VideoReader`` to ``torchvision.io`` if the upstream export is missing."""
+    global _applied
+    if _applied:
+        return
+
+    try:
+        import torchvision.io as tv_io
+    except ImportError:
+        _applied = True

+"""Compatibility shim for Hugging Face ``datasets`` + torchvision >= 0.26.
+
+OSS torchvision no longer exports ``torchvision.io.VideoReader`` (see pytorch/vision#9373).
+Older ``datasets`` versions do ``from torchvision.io import VideoReader`` inside
+``Video.encode_example``, which breaks ``load_dataset`` on video columns.
+
+This module injects ``torchvision.io.VideoReader`` using torchcodec when available,
+otherwise decord (already used elsewhere in this repo), so the import succeeds and
+decoding yields ``{"data": CHW tensor}`` as expected by ``_preprocess_videos``.
+
+Call :func:`apply_torchvision_io_video_reader_shim` before ``import datasets``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+import sys
+from typing import Any, Iterator, Optional, Type
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+_applied = False
+
+
+def apply_torchvision_io_video_reader_shim() -> None:
+    """Attach ``VideoReader`` to ``torchvision.io`` if the upstream export is missing."""
+    global _applied
+    if _applied:
+        return
+
+    try:
+        import torchvision.io as tv_io
+    except ImportError:
+        _applied = True
+        return
+
+    if getattr(tv_io, "VideoReader", None) is not None:
+        _applied = True
+        return
+
+    impl: Optional[Type[Any]] = None
+
+    # Prefer torchcodec (matches newer HF datasets).
+    try:
+        import torch
+        from torchcodec.decoders import VideoDecoder
+
+        def _stream_index_for_torchcodec(stream: str) -> Optional[int]:
+            if not isinstance(stream, str) or ":" not in stream:
+                return None
+            try:
+                return int(stream.rsplit(":", maxsplit=1)[-1])
+            except ValueError:
+                return None
+
+        class _TorchCodecVideoReader:
+            _hf_shim_video_reader = True
+
+            def __init__(self, src: Any, stream: str = "video") -> None:
+                stream_index = _stream_index_for_torchcodec(stream)
+                self._tc = VideoDecoder(
+                    src,
+                    stream_index=stream_index,
+                    dimension_order="NCHW",
+                    num_ffmpeg_threads=1,
+                    device="cpu",
+                    seek_mode="exact",
+                )
+
+            def __len__(self) -> int:
+                tc = getattr(self, "_tc", None)
+                if tc is not None:
+                    return len(tc)
+                raise TypeError("VideoReader length is unavailable for this reader instance")
+
+            def __iter__(self) -> Iterator[dict[str, Any]]:
+                tc = getattr(self, "_tc", None)
+                if tc is not None:
+                    for i in range(len(tc)):
+                        frame = tc[i]
+                        if frame.dim() == 4:
+                            frame = frame[0]
+                        yield {"data": frame}
+                    return
+

+

+

+                )
+
+        impl = _MissingDepsVideoReader
+
+    tv_io.VideoReader = impl  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    sys.modules.setdefault("torchvision.io", tv_io)
+    tv_io.__dict__["VideoReader"] = impl
+
+    _applied = True

**2. 🟠 Should fix: T5 encoders shipped only as safetensors fail to load: this PR forces `use_safetensors=False`**

`HFEmbedder` now calls `setdefault('use_safetensors', False)` for every non-CLIP encoder. **3. 🟠 Should fix: FPS and global throughput under-reported by accumulation factor: this PR counts one micro-batch per update**

`fps_gpu` divides `per_device_train_batch_size` by a CUDA-event window that spans all `grad_accum_steps` micro-batches of the update. With `gradient_accumulation_steps > 1`, the logged FPS and the wandb `throughput(global_samples/s)` are low by a factor of `accum`. `local_samples_in_update` is accumulated but used only as a `> 0` guard. Pass it (or `per_device * accum`) as `local_batch_size`.

**Who is affected:** AMDB benchmark runs that set `gradient_accumulation_steps > 1`; every shipped config uses 1.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

+        update_loss_count = 0
+        mlperf_train_started = False
+        count_flops = not bool(self.args.get("compile_transformer_blocks", False))
+        flop_counter = FlopCounterMode(display=False, depth=None) if count_flops else None
+        total_flops: float | None = None
+        flops_captured = flop_counter is None
+        flop_capture_open = False
+        if flop_counter is None and self.rank == 0:

+                "matching AMDiffusionBenchmark."
+            )
+        # AMDiffusionBenchmark synchronizes all ranks before both timing events so each
+        # step time excludes skew carried over from the previous step.
+        barrier_around_timing = (
+            not self.mlperf_enabled
+            and torch.distributed.is_available()
+            and torch.distributed.is_initialized()
+            and self.world_size > 1
+        )
+        start_event_gpu = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+        end_event_gpu = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+        accum = max(1, self.grad_accum_steps)
+        steps_per_epoch = math.ceil(len(self.dataloader) / accum)
+        start_epoch = self.global_step // steps_per_epoch
+        resume_batch_offset = (self.global_step % steps_per_epoch) * accum

+        for epoch in range(start_epoch, self.num_train_epochs):

+                batch = self._prepare_host_batch(batch)

+                    self._mlperf_log_train_start()
+                    mlperf_train_started = True
+                is_update_step = ((batch_idx + 1) % accum) == 0
+                starts_update = (batch_idx % accum) == 0
+                local_samples_in_update += self._infer_local_batch_size(batch)
+                if starts_update:

+                        torch.distributed.barrier()

+                            self.global_step,
+                            batch_idx,
+                            exc,

+                        detached_loss if update_loss_sum is None else update_loss_sum + detached_loss
+                    )
+                    update_loss_count += 1
+                    loss = raw_loss / accum

+
+                if is_update_step:

+                        loss_val = update_loss_sum / max(1, update_loss_count)

+                            flops_captured = True

**4. 🟠 Should fix: flux-dev ignores explicit `data.img_size` and rejects common resolution formats: this PR parses `resolution` naively**

For `flux-dev`, `apply_benchmark_sections` always overwrites `processor_config.img_size` with `int(str(resolution).split(',')[0])`. **Who is affected:** Users of the flux-dev benchmark config who set `data.img_size` instead of `RESOLUTION`, or who pass a non-integer resolution string.

**7. 🟠 Should fix: Benchmark trainer loop, flux-dev loading and routing lack unit tests: regressions slip past CI**

The new tests do not exercise the `amdb_benchmark` training loop (FPS with accumulation, cached-latent loader, `_collate_encoded`) or `build_flux_dev_benchmark` loading. They also do not cover the flux-dev precomputed/resolution routing or AMDB sampling. Non-flux `_SPECS` names (`sdxl`, `mochi-1`, `hunyuan-video`, `wan2.1-i2v`) get `amdb` defaults, but `MODEL_BUILDERS` has no entry for them; no test covers that routing. The fused RoPE equivalence test is skipped on hosts without a GPU.

**Who is affected:** Maintainers relying on unit tests to catch regressions in the new benchmark trainer and routing.

**8. 🟠 Should fix: q/k norms output fp32 with bf16 v on single GPU without pure low precision**

With `eps` set, `RMSNorm.forward` returns `(x.float()*rrms).to(x_dtype) * self.weight`, so a bf16 input times fp32 weights yields fp32. In the default benchmark config (`bf16=True`, `fsdp2_pure_low_precision=True`) the DiT is cast to bf16 before wrapping, and FSDP's `mp_policy` gives bf16 params on more than one GPU, so the output stays bf16. Only `fsdp2_pure_low_precision=False` with `world_size==1` gives bf16 activations with fp32 norm weights. Casting the result back to `x_dtype` would make that case consistent.

**Who is affected:** Single-GPU flux-dev benchmark runs that set `fsdp2_pure_low_precision: false`.

+"""AMDiffusionBenchmark trainer.
+
+FPS, TFLOPS, and the BF16 FSDP2 policy stay in this trainer so the shared
+Wan trainer is unchanged.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+import os
+import time
+from importlib import import_module
+
+import torch
+from torch.distributed._composable.fsdp import MixedPrecisionPolicy, fully_shard
+from torch.utils.flop_counter import FlopCounterMode
+
+from primus.backends.diffusion.trainers.base import (
+    ContiguousDistributedSampler,
+    benchmark_step_rates,
+)
+from primus.backends.diffusion.trainers.fsdp2 import FSDP2Trainer
+from primus.backends.diffusion.utils.log import logger
+from primus.backends.diffusion.utils.train_utils import get_memory
+
+try:
+    import wandb
+except ImportError:
+    wandb = None
+
+
+def _collate_encoded(samples: list[dict]) -> dict:
+    batch = {key: torch.stack([sample[key] for sample in samples]) for key in samples[0] if key != "prompt"}
+    if "prompt" in samples[0]:
+        batch["prompts"] = [sample["prompt"] for sample in samples]
+    return batch
+
+
+class AMDBBenchmarkTrainer(FSDP2Trainer):
+    _encoded_cache = False
+
+    def _cache_encoded_batches(self) -> None:
+        """Run the frozen encoders once over this rank's shard, as AMDiffusionBenchmark does.
+
+        The timed steps then see only the denoiser, so FPS and TFLOPS cover the same
+        work as AMDiffusionBenchmark's cached-latent runs.
+        """
+        core = getattr(self.model, "module", self.model)
+        encode = getattr(core, "encode_batch", None)
+        if not callable(encode):
+            return
+        cache_start = time.time()
+        self.sampler.set_epoch(0)
+        samples: list[dict] = []
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            for batch in self.dataloader:
+                batch = self._prepare_batch(self._prepare_host_batch(batch), self.processing_class)
+                prompts = list(batch.get("prompts") or [])
+                encoded = encode(batch)
+                if encoded is None:
+                    return
+                count = next(iter(encoded.values())).shape[0]
+                for index in range(count):
+                    sample = {key: value[index].detach().cpu() for key, value in encoded.items()}
+                    if index < len(prompts):
+                        sample["prompt"] = prompts[index]
+                    samples.append(sample)
+        if not samples:
+            raise RuntimeError("Latent caching produced no samples for this rank.")
+
+        offload = getattr(core, "offload_frozen_modules", None)
+        if callable(offload):
+            offload()
+        torch.cuda.empty_cache()
+
+        self.sampler = torch.utils.data.distributed.DistributedSampler(
+            samples,
+            num_replicas=1,
+            rank=0,
+            shuffle=self.args.get("shuffle", True),
+        )
+        self.dataloader = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(
+            samples,
+            batch_size=self.per_device_train_batch_size,
+            sampler=self.sampler,
+            collate_fn=_collate_encoded,
+            pin_memory=True,
+            drop_last=bool(self.args.get("dataloader_drop_last", False)),
+        )
+        self._encoded_cache = True
+        if self.rank == 0:
+            logger.info(
+                f"Cached {len(samples)} encoded samples per rank in {time.time() - cache_start:.1f}s; "
+                "frozen encoders offloaded to CPU."
+            )
+
+    def _prepare_batch(self, batch, processor):
+        if self._encoded_cache:
+            processor = None
+        return super()._prepare_batch(batch, processor)
+
+    def _prepare_host_batch(self, batch):
+        """Decode raw samples on the host before the step timer starts."""
+        if self._encoded_cache:
+            return batch
+        processor_hook = getattr(self.processing_class, "prepare_host_batch", None)
+        if callable(processor_hook):
+            return processor_hook(batch)
+        core = getattr(self.model, "module", self.model)
+        hook = getattr(core, "prepare_host_batch", None)
+        if not callable(hook):
+            return batch
+        if not isinstance(batch, dict):
+            prepare = getattr(self.processing_class, "prepare_batch", None)
+            if not callable(prepare):
+                return batch
+            batch = prepare(batch=batch, device=self.device, dtype=self._resolve_dtype())
+        return hook(batch)
+
+    def _apply_fsdp2(self):
+        """Apply torch.distributed._composable.fsdp.fully_shard to the model."""
+        mp_dtype = self._resolve_dtype()
+        # AMDiffusionBenchmark moves every frozen submodule to the training dtype.
+        cast_frozen = getattr(self.model, "cast_frozen_modules", None)
+        if callable(cast_frozen) and mp_dtype != torch.float32:
+            cast_frozen(mp_dtype)
+            if self.rank == 0:
+                logger.info(f"Cast frozen encoder modules to {mp_dtype}")
+        # AMDiffusionBenchmark casts the FSDP-wrapped denoiser to the training dtype, so
+        # parameters, gradients, reductions, and AdamW states all stay in BF16.
+        pure_low_precision = bool(self.args.get("fsdp2_pure_low_precision", False)) and (
+            mp_dtype != torch.float32
+        )
+        default_reduce = "bf16" if pure_low_precision else "fp32"
+        reduce_dtype_name = os.getenv("FSDP2_REDUCE_DTYPE", default_reduce).lower()
+        if reduce_dtype_name not in {"fp32", "bf16"}:
+            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported FSDP2_REDUCE_DTYPE={reduce_dtype_name!r}")
+        reduce_dtype = torch.float32 if reduce_dtype_name == "fp32" else torch.bfloat16
+
+        # Keep FP32 parameter/optimizer storage while allowing an explicit
+        # reduction-dtype experiment around the FP32-qualified default.
+        if mp_dtype != torch.float32:
+            mp_policy = MixedPrecisionPolicy(
+                param_dtype=mp_dtype,
+                reduce_dtype=reduce_dtype,
+            )
+        else:
+            mp_policy = None
+
+        # When SP is enabled, FSDP2 shards across dp_shard_sp (DP + SP combined).
+        # This reduces per-rank parameter memory.
+        fsdp_mesh = self.mesh
+        if self.mesh is not None and self.sp_group is not None:
+            try:
+                fsdp_mesh = self.mesh["dp_shard_sp"]
+            except KeyError:
+                pass  # fallback to full mesh
+
+        wrap_target = str(self.args.get("fsdp2_wrap_target", "") or "").strip()
+        wrap_root = (
+            self._get_module_by_path(self.model, wrap_target, option_name="fsdp2_wrap_target")
+            if wrap_target
+            else self.model
+        )
+
+        non_fp32_params = [
+            name for name, param in wrap_root.named_parameters() if param.dtype != torch.float32
+        ]
+        if non_fp32_params:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "TorchTitan-aligned FSDP2 requires FP32 parameter storage before wrapping; "
+                f"found non-FP32 parameters including {non_fp32_params[:3]}."
+            )
+        if pure_low_precision:
+            wrap_root.to(dtype=mp_dtype)
+            if self.rank == 0:
+                logger.info(
+                    f"FSDP2: cast '{wrap_target or '<model>'}' parameters to {mp_dtype} before sharding"
+                )
+
+        if self.world_size == 1:
+            if self.rank == 0:
+                logger.info("FSDP2: world_size=1; skipping composable FSDP wrapping.")
+            return
+
+        if bool(self.args.get("compile_transformer_blocks", False)):
+            self._compile_transformer_blocks(wrap_root)
+
+        reshard_after_forward = bool(self.args.get("fsdp2_reshard_after_forward", True))
+        no_reshard_paths = {
+            item.strip()
+            for item in str(self.args.get("fsdp_module_paths_no_reshard", "") or "").split(",")
+            if item.strip()
+        }
+
+        module_paths_spec = str(self.args.get("fsdp_module_paths_to_wrap", "") or "")
+        module_paths = [item.strip() for item in module_paths_spec.split(",") if item.strip()]
+        wrapped_paths = 0
+        for module_path in module_paths:
+            module = self._get_module_by_path(wrap_root, module_path, option_name="fsdp_module_paths_to_wrap")
+            fully_shard(
+                module,
+                mesh=fsdp_mesh,
+                reshard_after_forward=False if module_path in no_reshard_paths else reshard_after_forward,
+                mp_policy=mp_policy,
+            )
+            wrapped_paths += 1
+        if self.rank == 0 and wrapped_paths:
+            logger.info(
+                "FSDP2: wrapped explicit module paths under " f"'{wrap_target or '<model>'}': {module_paths}"
+            )
+
+        # Wrap transformer blocks first for optimal memory management
+        layer_cls_spec = self.args.get("fsdp_transformer_layer_cls_to_wrap")
+        if layer_cls_spec:
+            if isinstance(layer_cls_spec, str):
+                layer_cls_items = [x.strip() for x in layer_cls_spec.split(",") if x.strip()]
+            else:
+                layer_cls_items = [str(x).strip() for x in layer_cls_spec if str(x).strip()]
+
+            cls_objs = set()
+            cls_names = set()
+            for item in layer_cls_items:
+                if "." in item:
+                    mod_path, cls_name = item.rsplit(".", 1)
+                    cls_objs.add(getattr(import_module(mod_path), cls_name))
+                else:
+                    cls_names.add(item)
+
+            wrapped_count = 0
+            seen = set()
+            for _, module in wrap_root.named_modules():
+                if id(module) in seen:
+                    continue
+                seen.add(id(module))
+                if module is wrap_root:
+                    continue
+                checkpointed_module = getattr(module, "_checkpoint_wrapped_module", None)
+                target_module = checkpointed_module if checkpointed_module is not None else module
+                if (cls_objs and isinstance(target_module, tuple(cls_objs))) or (
+                    cls_names and target_module.__class__.__name__ in cls_names
+                ):
+                    fully_shard(
+                        module,
+                        mesh=fsdp_mesh,
+                        reshard_after_forward=reshard_after_forward,
+                        mp_policy=mp_policy,
+                    )
+                    if checkpointed_module is not None:
+                        seen.add(id(checkpointed_module))
+                    wrapped_count += 1
+
+            if self.rank == 0:
+                logger.info(f"FSDP2: wrapped {wrapped_count} submodules under '{wrap_target or '<model>'}'")
+
+        fully_shard(
+            wrap_root,
+            mesh=fsdp_mesh,
+            reshard_after_forward=reshard_after_forward,
+            mp_policy=mp_policy,
+        )
+        if self.rank == 0:
+            logger.info(
+                f"FSDP2: applied fully_shard to '{wrap_target or '<model>'}' "
+                f"with mp={mp_dtype}, reduce={reduce_dtype}"
+            )
+
+    def _log_step(
+        self,
+        loss_value: float | torch.Tensor,
+        step_loss_value: float | torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        grad_norm: float | torch.Tensor = 0.0,
+        step_time: float | None = None,
+        step_time_gpu: float | None = None,
+        elapsed: float | None = None,
+        eta_seconds: float | None = None,
+        throughput_samples_per_gpu_s: float | None = None,
+        fps_gpu: float | None = None,
+        tflops_per_gpu: float | None = None,
+    ):
+        """Log training metrics. Format matches test regex expectations."""
+        if self.rank != 0:
+            return
+        if isinstance(loss_value, torch.Tensor):
+            loss_value = loss_value.item()
+        if isinstance(step_loss_value, torch.Tensor):
+            step_loss_value = step_loss_value.item()
+        if step_loss_value is None:
+            step_loss_value = loss_value
+        if isinstance(grad_norm, torch.Tensor):
+            grad_norm = grad_norm.item()
+        if throughput_samples_per_gpu_s is None:
+            throughput_samples_per_gpu_s = fps_gpu
+        alloc, res, max_mem = get_memory()
+        lr = self.optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"]
+
+        # AMDiffusionBenchmark prints the local rank loss as step_loss and the
+        # all-reduced mean as train_loss. Those are different values.
+        msg = (
+            f"step={self.global_step} "
+            f"step_loss={step_loss_value:.6f} train_loss={loss_value:.6f} "
+            f"mem={alloc:.2f}/{res:.2f}GB peak_mem={max_mem:.2f}GB "
+            f"grad_norm={grad_norm:.4f}"
+        )
+        if step_time is not None:
+            msg += f" step_time_total={step_time:.6f}s"
+        if step_time_gpu is not None:
+            msg += f" step_time_gpu={step_time_gpu:.6f}s"
+        if fps_gpu is not None:
+            msg += f" fps_gpu={fps_gpu:.4f}"
+        if tflops_per_gpu is not None:
+            msg += f" tflops/s={tflops_per_gpu:.4f}"
+        if elapsed is not None:
+            msg += f" elapsed={elapsed / 60:.2f}m"
+        if eta_seconds is not None:
+            msg += f" eta={eta_seconds / 60:.2f}m"
+        logger.info(msg)
+
+        if self.use_wandb:
+            global_batch_size = (
+                self.per_device_train_batch_size * self.grad_accum_steps * self.data_parallel_world_size
+            )
+            payload = {
+                "train/loss": loss_value,
+                "step_loss": step_loss_value,
+                "train_loss": loss_value,
+                "train/step": self.global_step,
+                "train/grad_norm": grad_norm,
+                "train/lr": lr,
+                "train/samples_count": self.global_step * global_batch_size,
+                "loss_metrics/global_avg_loss": loss_value,
+                "lr": lr,
+                "mem/allocated_gb": alloc,
+                "mem/reserved_gb": res,
+                "mem/max_alloc_gb": max_mem,
+            }
+            if step_time is not None:
+                payload["step_time_total"] = step_time
+            if step_time_gpu is not None:
+                payload["step_time_gpu"] = step_time_gpu
+            if throughput_samples_per_gpu_s is not None:
+                global_throughput = throughput_samples_per_gpu_s * self.world_size
+                payload["perf/fps_gpu"] = throughput_samples_per_gpu_s
+                payload["throughput(global_samples/s)"] = global_throughput
+            if tflops_per_gpu is not None:
+                payload["tflops/s"] = tflops_per_gpu
+            if elapsed is not None:
+                payload["time/elapsed_s"] = elapsed
+            if eta_seconds is not None:
+                payload["time/eta_s"] = eta_seconds
+            wandb.log(payload, step=self.global_step)
+
+    def train(self):
+        if self.rank == 0:
+            logger.info("Starting training...")
+        self._mlperf_log_run_start()
+
+        # Ensure frozen state (idempotent)
+        core = getattr(self.model, "module", self.model)
+        if hasattr(core, "freeze_except"):
+            core.freeze_except()
+
+        if bool(self.args.get("cache_latents", True)) and not self.mlperf_enabled:
+            self._cache_encoded_batches()
+
+        self.model.train()
+        self.optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+        torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()
+
+        start_time = time.time()
+        local_samples_in_update = 0
+        update_loss_sum = None
+        update_loss_count = 0
+        mlperf_train_started = False
+        count_flops = not bool(self.args.get("compile_transformer_blocks", False))
+        flop_counter = FlopCounterMode(display=False, depth=None) if count_flops else None
+        total_flops: float | None = None
+        flops_captured = flop_counter is None
+        flop_capture_open = False
+        if flop_counter is None and self.rank == 0:
+            logger.warning(
+                "Disabling TFLOPS/GPU calculation because compile_transformer_blocks is enabled, "
+                "matching AMDiffusionBenchmark."
+            )
+        # AMDiffusionBenchmark synchronizes all ranks before both timing events so each
+        # step time excludes skew carried over from the previous step.
+        barrier_around_timing = (
+            not self.mlperf_enabled
+            and torch.distributed.is_available()
+            and torch.distributed.is_initialized()
+            and self.world_size > 1
+        )
+        start_event_gpu = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+        end_event_gpu = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+        accum = max(1, self.grad_accum_steps)
+        steps_per_epoch = math.ceil(len(self.dataloader) / accum)
+        start_epoch = self.global_step // steps_per_epoch
+        resume_batch_offset = (self.global_step % steps_per_epoch) * accum
+
+        for epoch in range(start_epoch, self.num_train_epochs):
+            self.sampler.set_epoch(epoch)
+            if isinstance(self.sampler, ContiguousDistributedSampler):
+                sample_offset = (
+                    resume_batch_offset * self.per_device_train_batch_size if epoch == start_epoch else 0
+                )
+                self.sampler.set_offset(sample_offset)
+
+            start_time_step = time.time()
+            for batch_idx, batch in enumerate(self.dataloader):
+                batch = self._prepare_host_batch(batch)
+                if self.mlperf_enabled and not mlperf_train_started:
+                    self._mlperf_log_train_start()
+                    mlperf_train_started = True
+                is_update_step = ((batch_idx + 1) % accum) == 0
+                starts_update = (batch_idx % accum) == 0
+                local_samples_in_update += self._infer_local_batch_size(batch)
+                if starts_update:
+                    if barrier_around_timing:
+                        torch.distributed.barrier()
+                    start_event_gpu.record()
+                    if flop_counter is not None and not flops_captured:
+                        flop_counter.__enter__()
+                        flop_capture_open = True
+                if is_update_step:
+                    self._mlperf_log_block_start(self.global_step + 1)
+
+                with self._grad_sync_context(is_update_step):
+                    try:
+                        raw_loss = self.compute_loss(batch)
+                    except BaseException as exc:
+                        if flop_capture_open:
+                            flop_counter.__exit__(type(exc), exc, exc.__traceback__)
+                            flop_capture_open = False
+                            flops_captured = True
+                        logger.exception(
+                            "Training forward failed at step %d, batch %d: %r",
+                            self.global_step,
+                            batch_idx,
+                            exc,
+                        )
+                        raise
+                    detached_loss = raw_loss.detach().float()
+                    update_loss_sum = (
+                        detached_loss if update_loss_sum is None else update_loss_sum + detached_loss
+                    )
+                    update_loss_count += 1
+                    loss = raw_loss / accum
+                    loss.backward()
+
+                if is_update_step:
+                    try:
+                        loss_val = update_loss_sum / max(1, update_loss_count)
+                        update_loss_sum = None
+                        update_loss_count = 0
+                        grad_norm = self._clip_grad_norm()
+                        self.optimizer.step()
+                        self.lr_scheduler.step()
+                        self.optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+                        if flop_capture_open:
+                            flop_counter.__exit__(None, None, None)
+                            flop_capture_open = False
+                            total_flops = float(flop_counter.get_total_flops())
+                            flops_captured = True
+                        if barrier_around_timing:
+                            torch.distributed.barrier()
+                        end_event_gpu.record()
+                        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+                        step_time_gpu = start_event_gpu.elapsed_time(end_event_gpu) / 1000.0
+                        # AMDiffusionBenchmark logs
+                        # fps_gpu = args.train_batch_size / step_time_gpu and
+                        # tflops/s = total_flops * 1e-12 / step_time_gpu.
+                        if step_time_gpu > 0 and local_samples_in_update > 0:
+                            step_fps, step_tflops = benchmark_step_rates(
+                                local_batch_size=self.per_device_train_batch_size,
